Also known as Bob Steele’s, The Boys Of New York, The Hand Down On My Tackle, Hand Down The Tackle, Hand Me Down My Tackle, Hand Me Down The Tackle, Hand Me Down The Tackles, Hielanman’s Kneebuckle, Miss Flanagan, The Pure Drop, Reidy Johnnson’s, Reidy Johnson, Reidy Johnson’s, Sin Chugam Anuas An Tacla, Tom Steele, Tom Steele’s, Tomás Stíl.

Twenty-three comments

Common Session Tune

A good solid common irish session tune, enjoyable on any instrument. AKA as “Reidy Johnson’s” & “Hand Me Down The Tackle”. One of the few tune names with a dangling participle.

↳ Posted by b.maloney on June 23rd, 2002.

Formulaic

The first beats of the 1st part are akin to the first beats of the 2nd part of The Wise Maid
https://thesession.org/tunes/118
while the first beats of the 2nd part can be found in The Peeler’s Jacket’s 2nd part (in G)
https://thesession.org/tunes/1343

Hand Me Down The Tackle - by Andy McGann, fiddle

I really like this setting by Andy McGann from the ITMA archives. The sound quality’s pretty poor, and he stumbles a bit in the middle, but that doesn’t matter to me. He does some pretty nifty things here; inspirational!

Maud Miller, reel ; Hand me down the tackle [Tom Steele’s], reel / Andy McGann, fiddle, speech ; Felix Dolan, piano
